calculation_kind: bounded evidence audit; no neural/body simulation
closed_reasons: No externally reviewed FlyVis-type to FlyWire-root-ID mapping for the frozen89E action chain.
No preregistered and independently validated descending/motor readout for foreleg rubbing, head grooming and reach-withdraw.
The pinned official repositories provide the components separately but no reviewed end-to-end mapping/readout for the three frozen89E actions.
Name matching, selected gains or a post-hoc adapter would manufacture rather than test the proposed mechanism.
allowed_conclusions: Series82-89E support a functional synthetic mirror-like surrogate: observation-derived internal state, delayed autonomous action reconstruction, causal digital lesions, actuator control and frozen replication under registered controls.
Series90 does not establish a reviewed biological chain, so no identified neuron in the model may be called a biological mirror neuron.
The current roadmap ends with mapping gate closed. Future biological work requires independent mapping/readout evidence and a new preregistration, not retrospective completion of series90.
forbidden_conclusions: Biological mirror neurons were discovered or proven.
FlyVis, Shiu/FlyWire and FlyGym currently form a validated natural observation-to-action mechanism for these three actions.
Synthetic lesion necessity proves necessity in a living fly.
source_audit_reason: As of the audit cutoff, no audited official source supplies both a reviewed FlyVis-type-to-FlyWire-ID mapping and a preregistered, validated descending/motor readout for the three frozen89E actions. Filling either gap by name matching or post-hoc gains would manufacture the desired behavior.
